title: CI/CD for Terraform IaC: PR linting, plan gating, and OPA/Conftest policy enforcement
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Implement a repeatable CI/CD workflow for Terraform IaC used by the Private (VPC) deployment product line. Pipeline goals: enforce linting/formatting in PRs, run terraform plan and surface human-readable diffs, block merges on policy violations (OPA/Conftest), produce signed plan artifacts for gated applies, and provide a safe apply workflow for staging and production including health checks and drift detection. This ticket covers pipeline implementation for core VPC modules (vpc-network, bastion, vpn-gateway) and a reference pattern for other modules.
acceptance_criteria: 1) PR pipeline runs terraform fmt, tflint, terraform validate, and Conftest/OPA policies; failures block the PR. 2) terraform plan runs in CI with remote state access (S3+DynamoDB) and plan JSON is uploaded as an artifact. 3) Policy-as-code set of rules (enforce KMS for storage, require module version pin, no public S3/ELB, require tags) implemented in Conftest and unit-tested. 4) Merge gating: merges require green CI and explicit 'infrastructure apply' run by ops pipeline; applies require an approver for destructive changes. 5) Staging workspace apply runs automated post-apply health checks (vpc reachability, bastion SSH test, internal service handshake) and reports results. 6) Scheduled drift-detection pipeline runs weekly and raises alerts to the infra channel on divergences. 7) Documentation and onboarding runbook added to Confluence and a sample PR template created.
proposed_solution: - Build a modular CI pipeline in GitHub Actions (or existing CI): 1) PR job: checkout, terraform fmt -check, tflint, terraform validate, plan (terraform plan -out=plan.binary -input=false) -> terraform show -json plan.binary -> run conftest test on JSON plan. 2) If conftest passes, upload plan.json as artifact and add plan summary as PR comment using existing plan-parsing tool. 3) Protect main branch so merges require the PR job to pass. 4) Apply pipeline: manual workflow that retrieves signed plan artifact, verifies approver signature (GitHub review or internal approvals service), and runs terraform apply -input=false plan.binary using a short-lived service account in the target workspace. 5) Implement policy-as-code in Conftest with rego policies covering encryption, network exposure, provider version pinning, required tags, and disallowed data-plane open access. 6) Add an infra-canary apply pattern: for network changes, first apply to staging workspace and run automated health-check jobs; only after health checks pass and a manual approval, run apply to production. 7) Store remote state in S3 with DynamoDB locks and strict IAM controls; use KMS for state encryption. 8) Add scheduled pipelines for drift detection and for running conftest against current state (terraform plan against live state with no changes).
tasks: Create PR linting workflow: fmt, tflint, validate
Integrate terraform plan -> plan.json artifact upload

Protect branches and configure required CI checks
Implement manual apply pipeline with approver gating

Write Confluence runbook and PR template
Migrate two sample modules (vpc-network, bastion) to new pipeline
